scenarios.name: 🛒 Order Processing
scenarios.description: E-commerce flow: validation, inventory check, payment, database, notifications (parallel). Use ?fail=true to simulate payment failure.

scenarios.name: 👤 User Registration
scenarios.description: Complete registration: validation, DB check, create user, parallel setup (profile, settings, avatar), notifications. Use ?failEmail=true to simulate email retry.

scenarios.name: 📊 Report Generation
scenarios.description: Data pipeline: parallel API fetches, data aggregation, PDF generation, parallel delivery (S3, email, Slack). Use ?timeout=true to simulate API timeout.

scenarios.name: Nested Coroutines
scenarios.description: Demonstrates parent-child relationships and structured concurrency

scenarios.name: Parallel Execution
scenarios.description: Multiple coroutines running in parallel

scenarios.name: Cancellation
scenarios.description: Demonstrates coroutine cancellation and cleanup

scenarios.name: Deep Nesting
scenarios.description: Deep hierarchy of nested coroutines (configurable depth)

scenarios.name: Mixed Sequential/Parallel
scenarios.description: Combination of sequential and parallel execution

scenarios.name: Exception Handling
scenarios.description: Demonstrates exception tracking and failure states

scenarios.name: Dispatcher Switching
scenarios.description: Runs work across Dispatchers.Default and Dispatchers.IO via VizDispatchers. Feeds the Dispatcher Overview: see dispatcher selection and thread assignment.

scenarios.name: Channel Rendezvous
scenarios.description: Zero-buffer channel where sender and receiver must meet for each transfer. Demonstrates suspension on both sides.

scenarios.name: Channel Buffered
scenarios.description: Buffered channel (capacity 3) showing buffer fill/drain. Producer sends 5 items, consumer starts after delay.

scenarios.name: Channel Fan-Out
scenarios.description: Fan-out pattern: one producer dispatches 10 tasks, 3 workers compete to receive and process them.

scenarios.name: Simple Flow
scenarios.description: Emit and collect 5 values from a cold Flow

scenarios.name: Flow Operators
scenarios.description: Chain map and filter operators on a flow

scenarios.name: StateFlow
scenarios.description: Mutable state with multiple observers

scenarios.name: SharedFlow
scenarios.description: Broadcast events to multiple subscribers

scenarios.name: Retry with Exponential Backoff
scenarios.description: Retry a failing operation 3 times with exponential backoff (100ms, 200ms, 400ms). Shows structured retry pattern for transient failures.

scenarios.name: Producer-Consumer
scenarios.description: Producer sends items to a buffered channel (capacity 5), consumer processes them with delay. Shows channel-based communication.

scenarios.name: Fan-Out / Fan-In
scenarios.description: Distribute work to multiple workers in parallel, results collected via channel. Shows work distribution pattern.

scenarios.name: Supervisor Pattern
scenarios.description: Launch children where one fails but siblings continue. Shows error isolation with structured concurrency.

scenarios.name: Circuit Breaker
scenarios.description: After N consecutive failures, stop trying for a cooldown period. Shows resilience pattern for protecting downstream services.

scenarios.name: Thread-Safe Counter
scenarios.description: Using mutex for atomic counter increments

scenarios.name: Bank Account Transfer
scenarios.description: Safe money transfer with consistent lock ordering

scenarios.name: Cache Read-Through
scenarios.description: Thread-safe lazy initialization pattern

scenarios.name: Deadlock Demo
scenarios.description: Intentional deadlock for detection demonstration

scenarios.name: Connection Pool
scenarios.description: Limiting concurrent database connections

scenarios.name: API Rate Limiter
scenarios.description: Throttling concurrent API calls

scenarios.name: File Processor
scenarios.description: I/O-limited parallel file processing

scenarios.name: Resource Timeout
scenarios.description: Resource acquisition with timeout

scenarios.name: Producer-Consumer
scenarios.description: Bounded buffer implementation

scenarios.description: Order processing with inventory and payment
